name: TCL 32L5A
summary: TCL 32L5A ships with a TCL account app, promo rows and preloaded browsers. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This small TCL set runs Android TV 11 and ships with a TCL account center, a TGuard cleaner app, promo and recommendation rows on the home screen, a TCL web video portal and a store demo sticker. It also has two preloaded browsers, a feedback reporter and a games service.

The list is short at twelve apps. TidyTV turns them off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. The Live TV app and the HDMI, AV and tuner inputs are kept, and every app can be switched back on.
keep: HDMI 1, HDMI 2, AV and tuner inputs

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 32L5A?
faq.a: This list does not touch Google Assistant, so the mic button is left as it is.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the promo and recommendation rows on the stock home and the TCL promotional service.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the stock Android TV home screen back.
